title: Chewy Vietnamese Chocolate Cookies
description: Soft-baked cookies with a rich cacao flavor, inspired by Indian spices. Perfect for snacking.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together flour, cacao powder, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in flour mixture until just combined.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto prepared baking sheet, leaving 2 inches of space between each cookie.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until edges are set.
Remove from oven and let cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
